ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_001.source_old: Good day Magistrate! may the Light bless you and your people.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_001.source_new: Good day Magistrate! May the Light bless you and your people.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_002.source_old: Thank you, Captain. What brings you and your men to Hillsbrad?
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_002.source_new: Thank you, Captain. What brings you and your men to Hillsbrad?

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_003.source_old: I would like an update on the evacuation of the civilian population, Magistrate, as the Horde could make its move at any moment.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_003.source_new: I would like an update on the evacuation of the civilian population, Magistrate, as the Horde could make its move at any moment.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_004.source_old: Ah yes, about that… I’m afraid the evacuation you requested is not going to happen.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_004.source_new: Ah yes, about that… I’m afraid the evacuation you requested is not going to happen.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_005.source_old: What? We warned you about the Horde’s intentions months ago! Who is responsible for this outrage?
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_005.source_new: What? We warned you about the Horde’s intentions months ago! Who is responsible for this outrage?

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_006.source_old: I am, captain. Suffice to say I remain unconvinced that a Horde offensive is as imminent as you and your kinsmen seem to think.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_006.source_new: I am, captain. Suffice to say I remain unconvinced that a Horde offensive is as imminent as you and your kinsmen seem to think.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_007.source_old: I have ordered our people to remain here, and tasked my officials with matters of much greater importance… such as trade.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_007.source_new: I have ordered our people to remain here, and tasked my officials with matters of much greater importance… such as trade.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_008.source_old: Are you serious? What about the recent attacks near Southshore? What about the assaults on the Durnholde prison camps?
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_008.source_new: Are you serious? What about the recent attacks near Southshore? What about the assaults on the Durnholde prison camps?

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_009.source_old: The Orcs have been testing us for months, captain, and none of what you describe indicate a change in behavior to me.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_009.source_new: The Orcs have been testing us for months, Captain, and none of what you describe indicate a change in behavior to me.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_010.source_old: This fearmongering is but the latest incarnation of a very old pattern. Kings and high lords will go to any length to justify their tax hikes, just so they can feed their armies and play their political games
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_010.source_new: This fearmongering is but the latest incarnation of a very old pattern. Kings and high lords will go to any length to justify their tax hikes, just so they can feed their armies and play their political games.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_011.source_old: Feeding their armies you say? Why then can I only see three dozen soldiers here?
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_011.source_new: Feeding their armies you say? Why then can I only see three dozen soldiers here?

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_012.source_old: I sent parts of our garrison to Tarren Mill. A recent increase in bandit activity demanded a response…
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_012.source_new: I sent parts of our garrison to Tarren Mill. A recent increase in bandit activity demanded a response…

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_013.source_old: My country was ruled by naive and shortsighted aristocrats. When the Horde came to my homeland, these people failed to realize the magnitude of the threat.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_013.source_new: My country was ruled by naive and shortsighted aristocrats. When the Horde came to my homeland, these people failed to realize the magnitude of the threat.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_014.source_old: They were too slow to act, too proud to ask for help and they led our nation to ruin. Now you are repeating that same mistake.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_014.source_new: They were too slow to act, too proud to ask for help and they led our nation to ruin. Now you are repeating that same mistake.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_015.source_old: I will take this matter to Lord Lothar, you will be held accountable for your negligence, Magistrate.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_015.source_new: I will take this matter to Lord Lothar, you will be held accountable for your negligence, Magistrate.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_016.source_old: Now now, Captain Meryn. There is really no reason to go that far! If the Horde really is about to attack Lordaeron, then what are you proposing that I do about it?
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_016.source_new: Now now, Captain Meryn. There is really no reason to go that far! If the Horde really is about to attack Lordaeron, then what are you proposing that I do about it?

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_017.source_old: Recall your troops from Tarren Mill, and reinforce your bulwarks. Send your civilians into Lordaeron’s interior, and prepare for the fight of your life… the Horde takes no prisoners, the Horde shows no mercy.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_017.source_new: Recall your troops from Tarren Mill, and reinforce your bulwarks. Send your civilians into Lordaeron’s interior, and prepare for the fight of your life… the Horde takes no prisoners, the Horde shows no mercy.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_018.source_old: I will… and Meryn, you can take some packhorses with food and supplies for your men.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_018.source_new: I will… and Meryn, you can take some packhorses with food and supplies for your men.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_019.source_old: Thank you, Magistrate. My men and I are done retreating. We will buy your people whatever time we can.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S001_019.source_new: Thank you, Magistrate. My men and I are done retreating. We will buy your people whatever time we can.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S002_002.source_old: The magistrate of Hillsbrad has neglected his duty, and left his Township and this region in mortal danger.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S002_002.source_new: The magistrate of Hillsbrad has neglected his duty, and left his Township and this region in mortal danger.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S002_003.source_old: The Horde is coming, we know it is, and it falls to us to distract them long enough for Hillsbrad to rally its defenses and send its people to safety.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S002_003.source_new: The Horde is coming, we know it is, and it falls to us to distract them long enough for Hillsbrad to rally its defenses and send its people to safety.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S002_004.source_old: This is it men, this is our final stand. This is our chance to avenge the ghosts of Stormwind!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S002_004.source_new: This is it men, this is our final stand. This is our chance to avenge the ghosts of Stormwind!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S002_005.source_old: The lion will roar, commander! I will hand out weapons and prepare our men for the battle ahead!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S002_005.source_new: The lion will roar, commander! I will hand out weapons and prepare our men for the battle ahead!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S002_006.source_old: Samwell. We will need to scout the nearby islands for any sign of Horde activity. If our fears are correct, then we must know when and where to strike – the fate of Hillsbrad depends on it.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S002_006.source_new: Samwell. We will need to scout the nearby islands for any sign of Horde activity. If our fears are correct, then we must know when and where to strike – the fate of Hillsbrad depends on it.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_001.source_old: I don’t understand this. The armada was supposed to have been here hours ago! If Doomhammer has lost his nerve, then I will carry out this invasion myself!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_001.source_new: I don’t understand this. The armada was supposed to have been here hours ago! If Doomhammer has lost his nerve, then I will carry out this invasion myself!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_002.source_old: My scouts be reporting dat the Armada be under attack by the Gilnean navy! Dey say dat the clash be very brutal, and very bloody!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_002.source_new: My scouts be reporting dat the Armada be under attack by the Gilnean navy! Dey say dat the clash be very brutal, and very bloody!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_003.source_old: Chieftain, in light of this development, should we not withdraw our forces to a more defensible position? Without the Armada we…
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_003.source_new: Chieftain, in light of this development, should we not withdraw our forces to a more defensible position? Without the Armada we…

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_004.source_old: No, Utok. The Armada will get here once it has crushed those Gilnean dogs, until then we will make do with what we have. What is our situation in terms of ship construction?
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_004.source_new: No, Utok. The Armada will get here once it has crushed those Gilnean dogs, until then we will make do with what we have. What is our situation in terms of ship construction?

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_005.source_old: Hmm… with the aid of new foundry sites we should be able to construct more advanced ships, including transports.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_005.source_new: Hmm… with the aid of new foundry sites we should be able to construct more advanced ships, including transports.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_006.source_old: That will enable us to deliver our forces across the channel to the cowering human settlements, and lay waste to Hillsbrad as the Warchief commands.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_006.source_new: That will enable us to deliver our forces across the channel to the cowering human settlements, and lay waste to Hillsbrad as the Warchief commands.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_007.source_old: Excellent Utok! All who oppose the Horde must be taught a harsh lesson this day… burn Hillsbrad to the ground! Leave no one alive!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S003_007.source_new: Excellent Utok! All who oppose the Horde must be taught a harsh lesson this day… burn Hillsbrad to the ground! Leave no one alive!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S004_001.source_old: Chieftain! Ships flying Gilnean colors are heading this way, they seem to be badly damaged!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S004_001.source_new: Chieftain! Ships flying Gilnean colors are heading this way, they seem to be badly damaged!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S004_002.source_old: Now be ya chance to show me how da Orcs be handeling fleeing prey, Rend Blackhand!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S004_002.source_new: Now be ya chance to show me how da Orcs be handeling fleeing prey, Rend Blackhand!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S004_003.source_old: Hahaha! I knew those weaklings would stand little chance against our glorious Armada! Make their defeat absolute… sink every last one of them!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S004_003.source_new: Hahaha! I knew those weaklings would stand little chance against our glorious Armada! Make their defeat absolute… sink every last one of them!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S005_001.source_old: Wait… are those Stormwind remnants? Kill them all!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S005_001.source_new: Wait… are those Stormwind remnants? Kill them all!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S005_002.source_old: Vile Beasts! You will pay for every innocent blood you spilled in Stormwind and all of Azeroth’s folk!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S005_002.source_new: Vile beasts! You will pay for every innocent blood you spilled in Stormwind and all of Azeroth’s folk!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S006_001.source_old: Wreched orcs! How dare you follow us to this land?!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S006_001.source_new: Wreched orcs! How dare you follow us to this land?!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S007_001.source_old: Time and time again, ya be showing me dat I made da right choice, Rend Blackhand!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S007_001.source_new: Time and time again, ya be showing me dat I made da right choice, Rend Blackhand!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S007_002.source_old: This is only the beginning, my friend, together we shall make this world trample beneath the might of the Horde!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S007_002.source_new: This is only the beginning, my friend, together we shall make this world tremble beneath the might of the Horde!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S008_001.source_old: Despite your frailty, you fight well, for a human
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S008_001.source_new: Despite your frailty, you fight well, for a human.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S008_002.source_old: Foolish creature… by attacking us… you have given Hillsbrad time to prepare… Light willing… they will be ready… for you
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S008_002.source_new: Foolish creatures… by attacking us… you have given Hillsbrad time to prepare… Light willing… they will be ready… for you.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S008_003.source_old: Now… get it… over with… you mindless savage.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S008_003.source_new: Now… get it… over with… you mindless savage.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S009_001.source_old: No! Meryn was right... what have I done? Light's mercy what have I done? Fortify the entrance! Fight men! defend the town!
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S009_001.source_new: No! Meryn was right... what have I done? Light's mercy what have I done? Fortify the entrance! Fight men! defend the town!

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S010_001.source_old: Please... spare my life... I'm very rich, I can give you all my gold....
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S010_001.source_new: Please... spare my life... I'm very rich, I can give you all my gold....

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S010_004.source_old: Lived without honor, and died without it.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S010_004.source_new: Lived without honor, and died without it.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S010_005.source_old: We all did a great job here. I will personally report to Doomhammer about your tactical talents, Utok. You will be promoted.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S010_005.source_new: We all did a great job here. I will personally report to Doomhammer about your tactical talents, Utok. You will be promoted.

ToD_A01_M04_VO_S010_006.source_old: Thank you, Chieftain. Serving the Horde is a great honor for me.
ToD_A01_M04_VO_S010_006.source_new: Thank you, Chieftain. Serving the Horde is a great honor for me.

ToD_A01_M04_OBJE_003.source_old: The time we have been waiting for has finally come! All who oppose the Horde must be taught a harsh lesson. Burn Hillsbrad to the ground - leave no one alive!
ToD_A01_M04_OBJE_003.source_new: The time we have been waiting for has finally come! All who oppose the Horde must be taught a harsh lesson. Burn Hillsbrad to the ground - leave no one alive!
